KORNER — FONT FILES
====================

Place the licensed Nemoy font files in this directory:

  Nemoy-Thin.woff2
  Nemoy-Medium.woff2
  Nemoy-Black.woff2

The site references them via @font-face declarations in src/index.css.
If the files are not present, the layout falls back to a neutral
geometric sans-serif automatically.

Nemoy is a commercial typeface — obtain a license before deploying.
